function.name: open_lafina_skill
function.description: Opens one study skill in the Skills tab when the student asks to use it ("start a pomodoro", "make flashcards", "quiz me", "make a reaction paper"). The app ends the call and opens the skill. It never generates, records or saves anything: the student uploads material and taps on that page. After it succeeds, say only the line in the result, then stop.

skill.description: Which skill: pomodoro (focus timer), flashcards, quiz, summarizer, materials (Lesson Q&A), docgen (essays, reports, slides, spreadsheets), meetings (class recorder), gwa (grade calculator), alarms, todo, notes, or hub (the Skills tab).

action.description: start: start a focus session (pomodoro). break: start a break (pomodoro). create: open the maker ready for material (flashcards, quiz, summarizer, docgen). review: review due flashcards. open: just open it.

breakKind.description: Pomodoro break length, for action break.

count.description: Questions or cards the student asked for (1..30).

topic.description: docgen or quiz only: the topic the student said, to pre-fill the field. Plain words, at most 200 characters.

material.description: The name of a saved lesson the student mentioned ("Chem 101"), to pre-select it.

function.name: read_skill_status
function.description: Reads the student’s study skills from the device: time left on the Pomodoro, flashcards due, GWA, or the last quiz score. Read only.

function.name: read_lafina_data
function.description: Reads the student’s schedule/calendar, to-do list, saved notes, alarms, or personal memories from local device storage.

kind.description: The type of local student data to read.

query.description: Optional search query, title, or date (YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow).

function.name: prepare_lafina_action
function.description: Prepares a to-do, task, event, time block, reminder, alarm, or note review card for student confirmation. Nothing is saved until the student confirms. Supply structured action, concise title and known date/time fields from the conversation; omit unknown details so the app can ask for them. Use prepare_multi_action for several items. Deleting needs the student’s own words.

request.description: The natural language description of the item to prepare.

action.description: What to prepare. Supply this for structured online interpretation.

title.description: Optional. Short title of the new item, or of the existing item to change.

newTitle.description: Optional. New title when renaming an existing item.

details.description: Optional. Note text or extra details.

deliveryStyle.description: Optional. For reminders: "call" rings a reminder call, "notify" posts an ordinary notification.

repeat.description: Optional, new items only. "daily", "weekdays", or "weekly:" plus two-letter days, e.g. "weekly:mo,we".

enabled.description: Optional. For toggle_alarm: true turns the alarm on, false turns it off. Name the alarm by "time" (HH:MM) or its label in "title".

function.name: find_free_time
function.description: Finds free windows on one day between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM that fit a session of the given length, using the student’s local calendar. Read-only.

date.description: Day to check (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

durationMinutes.description: Session length in minutes (15..720). Defaults to 60.

function.name: snooze_reminder
function.description: Snoozes the reminder this reminder call is about. Only works during a reminder call; use it when the student asks to be reminded again later.

function.name: save_lafina_memory
function.description: Proposes saving an explicit student memory or preference. Stated clearly in a card; nothing is saved without confirmation.

request.description: The explicit fact or preference the student requested to remember.

function.name: read_calendar
function.description: Reads local student calendar events and tasks within a date window.

function.name: search_notes
function.description: Searches local student notes by title or content.

limit.description: Max number of results to return (1..50).

function.name: read_memories
function.description: Reads saved student memories and personal study preferences from local storage.

query.description: Optional search keyword to match memories.

function.name: prepare_memory
function.description: Proposes saving an explicit student fact or preference. Prepares a card for user confirmation before saving.

text.description: The fact or preference to remember (1..200 chars).

function.name: revise_draft
function.description: Modifies an existing in-progress draft card (e.g. changing date, time, title, or duration) before confirmation.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to revise.

revision.description: The current revision number of the draft.

instruction.description: The spoken instruction describing what to change.

function.name: confirm_draft
function.description: Reports a draft save after the student explicitly confirms by speech or the card button. Never use this tool to authorize a save yourself.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to confirm.

function.name: cancel_draft
function.description: Cancels the pending draft card without modifying the student database.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to cancel.

revision.description: The current revision number of the draft.

function.name: prepare_multi_action
function.description: Prepares a grouped batch of student actions (tasks, calendar events, reminders) for review and confirmation.

text.description: Grouped spoken instruction or description of actions.

function.name: propose_follow_up_reminder
function.description: Proposes a context-driven follow-up reminder for an event or task with explicit user confirmation.

parentTitle.description: Title of the parent event or task.

minutesBefore.description: Minutes before parent event to trigger reminder.
